allowed: immutable reference to document issued in external accounting
productBoundary.safeRule: No PAID, SETTLED, REFUNDED or bank evidence command; external accounting handles financial settlement.
productBoundary.financeModule: Keep named finance module within 17 modules but scope it to commercial pricing analytics and external accounting handoff only.

tddCases.test: POST/PUT /payments or markPaid routes do not exist and cannot mutate commercial state
External bank callback with fake signed payload cannot create PaymentAllocation, refund or PAID
No payments, refunds, allocation, AR/AP ledger tables in R0 Flyway migrations
Customer/provider screens do not have pay, refund or mark-as-paid affordances
External accounting document reference never changes transportation or settlement state
No bank API secrets, payment gateway SDK, webhook or private financial payload in logs/telemetry

adapters.rule: Use user-controlled NCA EDS through browser; no private key on backend
eGov Mobile QR through verified third-party integration; do not assume unrestricted public API
Import independently signed original with cryptographic and authority validation

bindingOperations.condition: exact terms version and authorized representative EDS, BR-01
request alone never binding termination; BR-11

bindingOperations.action: binding signed POD/TTN or discrepancy act
bindingOperations.condition: BR-09/BR-10 legal profile; internal evidence remains distinct

operationalNoEdsByDefault: nonbinding RFQ submit after dedicated permission approval
validations: canonical frozen bytes/hash and exact domain object version
signature cryptography and NCA trust chain
certificate validity, revocation and signing time
signer authorization for exact legal entity and action
server-side verification, never trust browser boolean
signing.security: Never upload, store, request or log private key, key password or OTP. Protect certificate personal data and signed originals.
signing.atomicity: External signing is async: verified signed artifact staged durably; owner CAS state+audit+Outbox committed in one database transaction, with idempotent replay.
signing.denied: Unsigned, wrong signer, expired/revoked cert, wrong terms hash or unapproved legal profile cannot change binding state.

roadmap.historicTreatment: Payment positive cases tagged OUT_OF_SCOPE_R0 in historical acceptance bank, kept for traceability but not pilot release gate. Security absence tests PAY-ABS-01..06 mandatory.
